sn9.13:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū Kosalesu viharanti aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe uddhatā uṇṇaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā || || Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tesam bhikkhūnaṃ anukampikā atthakāmā te bhikkhū saṃvejetukāmā yena te bhikkhū ten-upasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.13:2.1: Sukhajīvino pure āsuṃ || bhikkhū Gotama-sāvakā || anicchā piṇḍam esanā || anicchā sayanāsanaṃ || loke aniccataṃ ñatvā || dukkhass-antam akaṃsu te || ||
sn9.13:3.1: dupposaṃ katvā attānam || gāme gāmaṇikā viya || bhutvā bhutvā nipajjanti || parāgāresu mucchitā ||
sn9.13:4.1: saṅghassa añjaliṃ katvā || idh-ekacce vadām-ahaṃ || || appaviddhā anāthā te || yathā petā tath-eva te ||
sn9.13:5.1: ye kho pamattā viharanti || te me sandhāya bhāsitaṃ || ye appamattā viharanti || namo tesaṃ karom-ahanti || ||
sn9.13:6.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū tāya devatāya saṃvejitā saṃvegam āpādun ti || ||
